urdu: سابق وزیر اعظم شہباز شریف نے تھر کوئلہ مائنز اور قومی ریلوے نیٹ ورک کے درمیان کنکشن کے لیے مارچ 2023ء تک کی کیا ہدایت جاری کی؟
english: What directive did former Prime Minister Shahbaz Sharif issue regarding the connection between Thar coal mines and the national railway network by March 2023?
roman_1: Sabiq Wazir-e-Azam Shahbaz Sharif ne Thar koila mines aur qoumi railway network ke darmiyan connection ke liye March 2023 tak kiya hidayat jari ki?
roman_2: Sabiq Wazir e Azam Shahbaz Sharif ne Thar coal mines aur qaumi railway network ke darmiyan connection ke liye March 2023 tak kya hidaayaat jari ki?
roman_3: Sabiq Wazir Azam Shahbaz Shareef ne Thar koila mines aur qoumi railway network ke darmiyan connection ke liye March 2023 tak kis tarah ki hidaayat jari ki?
